title: Unlocking the capacity of Mn-based Prussian blue cathodes in capacitive deionization
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75403-z

Freshwater scarcity drives the need for better desalination. Here, authors develop a potassium-substituted, high-entropy manganese-based Prussian blue cathode that achieves high capacity, stability, and energy recovery in capacitive deionization.

title: Alternatively spliced killer–protector system confers S19-mediated hybrid male sterility in rice
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74581-0

Tang et al. report a killer–protector system of S19 locus for interspecific hybrid sterility and demonstrate that alternatively spliced killer transcripts confer the toxicity diversity due to mRNA abundance, protein stability and conformation.

title: Loss of the USP22 deubiquitylase confers resistance to chemotherapy in small cell lung cancer
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75117-2

While small cell lung cancer (SCLC) typically responds well to chemotherapy, resistance often develops rapidly with limited therapeutic options. Here, using an in vivo CRISPR deletion screen in patient derived models of SCLC, the authors identify the SAGA deubiquitylase USP22 as a driver of cisplatin resistance in SCLC.

title: Spliceosomal proteins direct RNA methylation to modulate gene expression and silence retrotransposons
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75362-5

RNA modifications help determine how RNAs are processed and regulated. Here, the authors identify a pathway in fission yeast in which Tgs1-mediated RNA capping recruits RNAi machinery to target cryptic-intron-containing transcripts, promoting their processing and silencing.

title: The OsMYB4 transcription factor enables coordinated improvement of grain yield and quality in rice
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 07 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75179-2

Trade-offs between grain yield and quality limits the scope for their improvement. Here, the authors report that OsMYB4 is a key regulator of both traits in rice, and the elite OsMYB4-Hap1 allele offers a promising strategy for synergistic crop breeding.
